source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
If there is a deviation reported, document the specification if written, else document the pass/fail criteria for the performance test report.
3. Add relevant and required information to the report such as supplier, part number, quantity tested, sample preparation instructions, test instructions, deviation type, etc.

# Instructions for test records.

1. When writing a test record, you should be saving each record to a different folder with an objective file naming convention that uses both the specification and the test method as a directory from the root.

Examples of a folder structure with these test records:

1. C:\Users\User\My Documents\Test Records\TestingSuite_name
   1. Record Date_Date Tested
      1. Unit_#
2. C:\Users\User\My Documents\Test Records\TestingSuite_name\TestName_RecordName
   1. Record Date_Date Tested
      1. Unit
